description.value: Mi Tierra Latina is a Latin American specialty grocery store on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, offering products from over nine countries including Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, and Peru. The store carries a broad range of shelf-stable and frozen goods, from traditional Colombian empanadas and bunuelos to Juan Valdez coffee and regional sauces and spices. Commercial Drive is a well-established cycling corridor in Vancouver, making this a convenient resupply stop for touring cyclists seeking specialty or ethnic grocery items.
